title: Exclusive Black Friday and Cyber Monday Sales at OPENLANE
summary: Two exclusive sales events between Wednesday 25 November and Tuesday 1 December 2026.
body_markdown:
# Exclusive Black Friday and Cyber Monday Sales at OPENLANE


** 23 Nov 2026


**OPENLANE, a leading digital marketplace for used vehicles, is bringing Black Friday and Cyber Monday excitement to professional car traders across Europe. Discover hundreds of attractive vehicle deals across two exclusive sales events, featuring competitive fixed Buy now prices. Visit openlane.eu during the sales events between 25 November and 1 December and secure the vehicles that fit your business. But be quick: vehicles are sold on a first-come, first-served basis!**


**Tienen, Belgium, 23 November 2026** – In a competitive used-car market, access to the right stock at the right price is essential for professional car traders. This year, OPENLANE is bringing the Black Friday and Cyber Monday shopping phenomenon to Europe’s automotive trade, offering dealers two exclusive opportunities to replenish their stock at attractive, reduced prices.


## Black Friday: Hundreds of stock deals at the lowest Buy now prices


From **[Wednesday 25 November at 10:30 CET to Friday 27 November at 16:00 CET](https://www.openlane.eu/en/findcar?auctionBatchId=361510)** , professional buyers can discover hundreds of stock vehicles at the lowest “Buy now” prices. The selection brings together stock from across European markets, offering car professionals the opportunity to source attractive vehicles, diversify their inventory and protect their margins.


## Cyber Monday: Fresh dealer cars and more, plus a €200 voucher


From[Saturday 28 November at 09:00 CET to Tuesday 1 December at 16:00 CET](https://www.openlane.eu/en/findcar?auctionBatchId=361511) , the spotlight shifts to a selection of attractive vehicles, primarily sourced from professional traders and dealers. Buyers purchasing a vehicle during this exclusive sale will also unlock a €200 voucher* towards their next OPENLANE purchase (*[Terms & Conditions apply](https://info.openlane.eu/en/cyber-monday/) ).


## First come, first served. Don’t miss out!


Both sales events feature fixed Buy now prices, meaning no bidding, no waiting and no uncertainty. The first buyer to complete the purchase secures the vehicle. With attractive deals available for a limited time, speed is key.


Once a vehicle is secured, buyers can count on OPENLANE’s trusted services for a smooth and hassle-free transaction. From secure online payments and multilingual customer support to cross-border documentation, transport and delivery, and additional services such as Optimo, OPENLANE supports professional traders every step of the way, from purchase to delivery.


**Mark your calendars!** The Black Friday sale kicks off on Wednesday 25 November at 10:30 CET, followed by Cyber Monday on Saturday 28 November at 09:00 CET. Visit[openlane.eu](https://www.openlane.eu/en/home) , explore the offers and be ready when the sales open.


**Remember: The first to buy gets the car. Don’t be late!**


## About OPENLANE Europe


OPENLANE Europe, a business unit of global vehicle remarketing and technology solutions provider OPENLANE (NYSE: OPLN), makes used car wholesale easy for its customers so they can be successful. The company seamlessly connects OEMS, Fleet owners, wholesalers, and dealers with buyers in more than 50 countries across Europe. Its robust online car marketplace reduces risk, improves transparency and streamlines transactions. Headquartered in Belgium, OPENLANE Europe has sales operations in Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain, and the United Kingdom. For more information, visit[openlane.eu](https://www.openlane.eu/)


.


## About OPENLANE Inc.


OPENLANE, Inc. (NYSE: OPLN) makes wholesale easy by connecting the leading automotive manufacturers, dealers, rental companies, fleet operators, captive finance and lending institutions as buyers and sellers to create the most advanced digital marketplace for used vehicles. Our innovative products and services deliver a fast, fair and transparent experience that helps customers make smarter decisions and achieve better outcomes. Headquartered in Carmel, Indiana, OPENLANE has employees across the United States, Canada, Europe, Uruguay and the Philippines. For more information and the latest OPENLANE news, visit[corporate.openlane.com](https://corporate.openlane.com/)
